title: Rohan Jaspal
text:
Data Engineering & Analytics: Proficient in SQL for database design and Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn) for data manipulation and modeling.
Statistical Programming: Experienced in R using the tidyverse and ggplot2 packages for data tidying and visualization.
Advanced Mathematics: Strong foundation in Linear Algebra, Multivariable Calculus, and Statistical Theory.





University Student: Currently in the second year of junior year, maintaining a focus on academic performance and GPA protection.
Data Science Coursework: Completed advanced courses in Multivariable Calculus and Statistics.
Professional Development: Serving as a Scheduling & Operations Lead, gaining hands-on experience in operational management and team coordination.
